boundaryLayer.reason: M is audit-real but not in the committed legal-move catalog; the path finder does not walk M, so no alternative-route enumeration exists for the boundary layer
boundaryLayer.storageGapNote: boundary-layer heptatonic nodes carry no native office pools and D-anchors have no office-network seating (BL-029); transport semantics do not apply, geometry is recorded only

directionFields.basis: no admitted source maps court position or kernel window to Earth-ward/Fire-ward meaning; transport records geometry only and never assigns direction

structuralNotes: transport origins at distance 2-3 are disjoint from census claimants at distance 1, so multi-hop transport extends origin sets and can never reproduce or resolve a one-hop collision
every one of the 330 pentatonic targets receives at least two distinct seed origins within 3 hops; transported office semantics is universally multi-origin on this graph
cross-office pool arrivals are disjoint except on the admitted pool-intersection inventory carried in preRegistration.expectedPoolOverlaps
75 visually-windowed triples per seed remain at hop distance >= 4 (65/65/65/65/65/65/65 per seed); depth beyond 3 is a census fact only, not sampled

preRegistration.collisionRule: transport arrivals extend origin sets; resolution would require an admitted semantic rule and is pre-registered as unexpected
preRegistration.crossOriginRule: cross-office arrivals must be disjoint unless the office pair appears in expectedPoolOverlaps, where the relation must be overlapping with exactly the listed shared strings
preRegistration.deviationRule: identical/subset cross-office relations, or overlaps outside the admitted inventory, are fail-loud deviations
preRegistration.directionRule: direction is recorded as unassigned, never inferred
preRegistration.minimalPathCountRule: exact when pathCountCapped is false; a capped count means at least 26 minimal paths under the 25-path budget
preRegistration.officeComparison: different origins are distinct offices by construction; every cross-origin comparison is cross-office
preRegistration.sameOriginControl: one origin's pool is carried verbatim on every route; same-origin multi-route agreement is a control, never a finding
